standard.summary: 选择 Anima 模型根目录，自动识别并填充 DiT / VAE / Qwen3 / T5 Tokenizer / LLM Adapter 路径字段。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Pick the Anima model root directory and the DiT / VAE / Qwen3 / T5 tokenizer / LLM adapter path fields are detected and filled in for you.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: 选择 Anima 模型根目录，自动识别并填充 DiT / VAE / Qwen3 / T5 Tokenizer / LLM Adapter 路径字段。支持文件名模式 + safetensors 架构检测（仅读文件头，不加载权重）。

advanced_en.principle: Pick an Anima model root directory and the DiT / VAE / Qwen3 / T5 Tokenizer / LLM Adapter path fields are auto-detected and filled in. Supports filename patterns plus safetensors architecture probing (reads only file headers, never loads weights).
